
```{r}
#| label: merge-lifestyle

datasets <- list(
  f01_duke_uplc,
  f04_npi,
  f06_medhist
)

# Convert all RID variables to the same type
datasets <- lapply(datasets, function(x) {
  x |>
    mutate(RID = as.double(RID))
})

# Merge all datasets by RID

7lifestyle_sa <- reduce(datasets, full_join, by = "RID") |>
  select(RID, DHA, EPA, HCys, NPIK, NPIKTOT, MH14ALCH, MH16SMOK)



write.csv(lifestyle_sa, "lifestyle-sa.csv", row.names = FALSE)




```

```{r}
#| label: merge-subtype


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

subtype_lifestyle_matched_pv <- subtype_lifestyle_matched |>
  group_by(`Subtype Assignment`) |>
  summarise(
    prop_smoke = mean(MH16SMOK, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_drink = mean(MH14ALCH, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prop_"), 
               names_to = "behavior", 
               values_to = "proportion") |>
  mutate(behavior = recode(behavior, prop_smoke = "Smoke", prop_drink = "Drink"))

ggplot(subtype_lifestyle_matched_pv, aes(x = factor(`Subtype Assignment`), y = proportion, fill = behavior)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Subtype",
    y = "Proportion (%)",
    fill = "Behavior",
    title = "Proportion of People Who Smoke and Drink by Subtype"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Prepare data for smoking and drinking
subtype_lifestyle_matched_ALCSMO <- subtype_lifestyle_matched %>%
  select(`Subtype Assignment`, MH16SMOK, MH14ALCH) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MH16SMOK, MH14ALCH), 
               names_to = "Behavior", 
               values_to = "Status") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Status)) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = recode(Behavior, MH16SMOK = "Smoking", MH14ALCH = "Drinking"),
    Status = ifelse(Status == 1, "Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Subtype Assignment`, Behavior, Status) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(`Subtype Assignment`, Behavior) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))

# Plot stacked bars with facets for Behavior
ggplot(subtype_lifestyle_matched_ALCSMO, aes(x = factor(`Subtype assignment`), y = proportion, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#D55E00", "No" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    x = "SUBTYPE",
    y = "PROPORTION (%)",
    fill = "STATUS",
    title = "PROPORTION OF SMOKERS AND DRINKERS BY SUBTYPE"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Behavior) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )




```
